explanation: Using y₁=e^x cos(2x) and y₂=e^x sin(2x), the Wronskian is 2e^(2x). Variation of parameters gives u₁′=−2 and u₂′=2cot(2x), hence u₁=−2x and u₂=ln|sin(2x)|. Therefore g=e^x[sin(2x)ln|sin(2x)|−2x cos(2x)], valid where sin(2x)≠0. This tests variation of parameters for second-order ODEs, absent from the supplied course topics.
